gates.criterion: The braided trim is attached along the visible edge of the foreground woman's left sleeve cuff, not floating, painted on a surface or on another owner.
The trim shows distinguishable braided thread organization rather than a plain printed stripe.
The actual end of that same braid visibly joins the tassel head without a missing or obscured connection.
Separate loose thread strands hang below that same attached tassel head with coherent gravity and space.

claim_boundaries: A gold appearance does not prove metal content.
